system.description:
3rd Level Clan Feature, [Mnemonic Branch]

You have developed an album of songs meant to bring ruin to your foes, but victory to you and your allies. These songs are known as your Mnemodies. While they have predefined names here, you can name them as you please. You can prepare up to 2 Mnemodies when you complete a long rest. You can prepare 1 additional song at 7th and 15th levels. You memorize prepared songs until you begin a long rest.

If a song would trigger as part of casting a Kashu Clan Hijutsu, its affects are only applied if the affected creatures fail their saving throw. If the Kashu Jutsu cast does not force a saving throw, then they must make a Wisdom saving throw vs your highest jutsu save DC, suffering the songs effects on a failure.

Haunting Notes

You gain the Haunting Note attack. Also, when a creature triggers one of your Bell Wires, you can choose to instead make a Haunting Note attack at no additional action, instead of spending your Reaction.

When you take the Attack action, you can replace any number of attack you make with a Haunting Note attack. If you do not have the Extra Attack feature, beginning at 7th level, you can make two Haunting Note attacks instead of one.

Haunting Note. Make a ranged Ninjutsu (or Genjutsu) attack using your highest jutsu attack bonus against a creature you can see within 30 feet of you or an active Bell Wire. On a hit, you deal 1d8 psychic damage. If a target already has at least 1 rank of Disorientation, they must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, they gain ranks of Dazzled equal to their ranks of Disorientation.

Multi-Traps

You can place 2 Bell Wires as a Bonus action on your turn. They must be in different locations and their areas cannot overlap.

Hair Trigger

Bell Wires you place, now trigger on any movement through their space, including forced movement.

I Planned For This

When a hostile creature deals damage to you as a result of a melee attack, you can spend your reaction to dispel an active Bell Wire. If you do, Select one Kashu Clan Hijutsu you know of D-Rank that forces a saving throw and cast it as part of this reaction, at no chakra cost targeting them.

The rank of jutsu you can cast increases to C-Rank at 7th level and B-Rank at 15th level.

Taut String

Once per turn, when a creature within 30 feet of a Bell Wire casts a jutsu with the Hand Sign (HS) component, you can spend your reaction to Dispel that Bell Wire. When you do, the triggering creature must make a Wisdom saving throw as they begin to hear music from all directions. On a failure, they become Confused for the next minute. A creature Confused in this way remakes their saving throw at the end of each of their turns, ending the Confused condition on a success.

Cruel Reverb

When a creature triggers a Bell Wire, you can choose to instead have the triggering creature make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, they become Berserk for the next minute. A creature that is Berserk in this way ends this condition the first time they deal damage to a creature they previously considered an ally.

Patient Trap

You can now place Bell Wires outside of combat. Bell Wires placed in this way persist for up to 24 hours before fading.

Bell Wires placed this way are always delayed and do not trigger automatically. They always alert you to a creature crossing its affected area. If combat would begin and a creature is standing in your Bell Wires affected area, they automatically trigger, forcing them to make their Initiative roll at disadvantage, and you can use your triggered Bell Wires effects as part of initiative being rolled. You can maintain up to 4 Bell Wires outside of combat.

Lingering Bell

When a Bell Wire is triggered, you can choose to instead mark them as a Lingering Bell. A creature marked as a Lingering Bell remains marked for up to 1 minute. You can spend your Bonus action on your turn or Reaction on other creatures turn to detonate a Lingering Bell. Once detonated, all creatures within 20-feet of a Lingering Bell must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, they become Slowed and gain 1 rank of Concussed.

Increase the ranks of Concussed by +1 at 7th and 15th levels.
